name: io.github.igorolv/redmine-mcp-server
title: Redmine MCP Server
description: Redmine for AI agents: issues, projects, wiki, attachments, time entries and release analytics

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Redmine instance, e.g. https://redmine.example.com

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Redmine API key of the user the server acts as (My account -> API access key)

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_MCP_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to also expose the issue, note, attachment, time-entry and wiki write tools
